### Severity Classification
- [ ] CRITICAL (Immediate exploitation or data compromise)
- [ ] HIGH (Significant security degradation)
- [ ] MEDIUM (Moderate compliance or detection bypass)
- [ ] LOW (Informational / defense hardening)
